tool_input.command: gcloud ai feature-groups --help 2>&1 | head -20; echo "===FOS==="; gcloud ai feature-online-stores --help 2>&1 | head -20

bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT show --format=prettyjson $GCP_PROJECT:$GCP_BQ_DATASET 2>&1 | grep -iE '"location"|"id"|datasetReference|"tableReference"' | head; echo "===TABLES==="; bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT ls --format=prettyjson $GCP_BQ_DATASET 2>&1 | head -40
tool_input.description: Show dataset location and existing tables

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT load --noreplace --source_format=CSV --skip_leading_rows=1 \
  $GCP_BQ_DATASET.accountsed4daa_staging ./data/batch_2.csv \
  row_id:STRING,status:STRING,balance:FLOAT,updated_at:INTEGER 2>&1 | tail -1
bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT load --noreplace --source_format=CSV --skip_leading_rows=1 \
  $GCP_BQ_DATASET.accountsed4daa_staging ./data/batch_3.csv \
  row_id:STRING,status:STRING,balance:FLOAT,updated_at:INTEGER 2>&1 | tail -1
tool_input.description: Append batch_2 and batch_3 to staging

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=none \
"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE \`$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET.accountsed4daa\` AS
 SELECT row_id, status, balance, updated_at,
        TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(updated_at) AS feature_timestamp
 FROM (
   SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY row_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC) rn
   FROM \`$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET.accountsed4daa_staging\`
 )
 WHERE rn = 1" 2>&1 | tail -2

bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT query --use_legacy_sql=false --replace \
  --destination_table=$GCP_BQ_DATASET.accountsed4daa --format=none \
"SELECT row_id, status, balance, updated_at, TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(updated_at) AS feature_timestamp FROM ( SELECT row_id, status, balance, updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY row_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC) rn FROM $GCP_BQ_DATASET.accountsed4daa_staging ) WHERE rn = 1" 2>&1 | tail -3
tool_input.description: Create deduped feature table via destination_table

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty \
"SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM $GCP_BQ_DATASET.accountsed4daa_staging) AS staging_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM $GCP_BQ_DATASET.accountsed4daa) AS final_rows, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT row_id) FROM $GCP_BQ_DATASET.accountsed4daa) AS distinct_ids" 2>&1 | tail -6

bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty \
"SELECT COUNT(*) AS mismatches FROM ( SELECT f.row_id FROM $GCP_BQ_DATASET.accountsed4daa f JOIN ( SELECT row_id, MAX(updated_at) mx FROM $GCP_BQ_DATASET.accountsed4daa_staging GROUP BY row_id) s ON f.row_id=s.row_id WHERE f.updated_at != s.mx )" 2>&1 | tail -5
tool_input.description: Confirm kept rows match max updated_at

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id=$GCP_PROJECT query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty \
"SELECT * FROM $GCP_BQ_DATASET.accountsed4daa ORDER BY row_id LIMIT 5" 2>&1 | tail -10
